story.titleZh: 斯特罗尔因病毒感染缺席Interlagos赛道一日
story.summaryZh: 拉塞尔·斯特罗尔因在墨西哥感染病毒而继续恢复，将缺席Interlagos赛道的一天，预计周五回归。
story.originalTitle: Lance Stroll the latest driver to need to miss a day at the track, with Aston Martin saying his absence at Interlagos is as he continues to recover fr...
story.summaryEn: Lance Stroll the latest driver to need to miss a day at the track, with Aston Martin saying his absence at Interlagos is as he continues to recover from a viral infection contracted in Mexico. Expected back on Friday #F1
detailZh: 斯特罗尔 是最新一位需要缺席一天赛道活动的车手，阿斯顿·马丁表示他在Interlagos的缺席是因为他正在继续从在墨西哥感染的一种病毒中恢复。预计他将于周五回归F1 #F1
detailEn: Lance Stroll the latest driver to need to miss a day at the track, with Aston Martin saying his absence at Interlagos is as he continues to recover from a viral infection contracted in Mexico. Expected back on Friday #F1
story.leadZh: 拉塞尔·斯特罗尔因在墨西哥感染病毒而继续恢复，将缺席Interlagos赛道的一天，预计周五回归。
bodyZh: 拉塞尔·斯特罗尔因在墨西哥感染病毒而继续恢复，将缺席Interlagos赛道的一天，预计周五回归。

relatedItems.titleZh: FP2无胡肯博格，奥迪继续排查赛车疑似电气问题
relatedItems.summaryZh: 胡肯博格在FP2练习中缺席，奥迪车队正在努力找出赛车在FP1练习中因疑似电气问题而停车的故障原因。
relatedItems.originalTitle: No Hulkenberg in FP2 as Audi continues trying to identify the cause of a suspected electrical issue on the car that stopped it in FP1 when Slater was ...
relatedItems.summaryEn: No Hulkenberg in FP2 as Audi continues trying to identify the cause of a suspected electrical issue on the car that stopped it in FP1 when Slater was driving #F1 #BrazilGP
detailZh: FP2没有胡尔肯伯格，奥迪车队继续试图找出导致赛车在FP1中因疑似电气问题而停止的原因，当时斯莱特正在驾驶#F1 #巴西大奖赛
detailEn: No Hulkenberg in FP2 as Audi continues trying to identify the cause of a suspected electrical issue on the car that stopped it in FP1 when Slater was driving #F1 #BrazilGP

relatedItems.titleZh: 赫塔获得FP1超级驾照积分，可申请超级驾照 #F1 #巴西大奖赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 赫塔完成100公里FP1赛事，获得积分，可申请超级驾照；凯迪拉克确认赫塔将在Interlagos进行另一场FP1赛事，以获得最后的超级驾照积分。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Herta’s hit the magic 100km for an FP1 Super Licence point, so he’s able to apply for that licence now #F1 #BrazilGP
relatedItems.summaryEn:
Herta’s hit the magic 100km for an FP1 Super Licence point, so he’s able to apply for that licence now #F1 #BrazilGPChris Medland: Confirmation from Cadillac of another FP1 outing for Colton Herta at Interlagos, as he goes in search of that final Super Licence point
A clean FP1 with enough running will allow him to apply for a Super Licence, and could see him replace Valtteri Bottas next season #F1
detailZh:
赫塔完成100公里FP1赛事获得积分，因此他现在可以申请超级驾照 #F1 #巴西大奖赛Chris Medland：凯迪拉克确认，科顿·赫塔将在Interlagos进行另一场FP1赛事，以获得最后的超级驾照积分。
一场干净的FP1赛事，只要跑足足够的里程，将允许他申请超级驾照，并可能使他下赛季取代瓦尔特里·博塔斯 #F1
detailEn:
Herta’s hit the magic 100km for an FP1 Super Licence point, so he’s able to apply for that licence now #F1 #BrazilGPChris Medland: Confirmation from Cadillac of another FP1 outing for Colton Herta at Interlagos, as he goes in search of that final Super Licence point
A clean FP1 with enough running will allow him to apply for a Super Licence, and could see him replace Valtteri Bottas next season #F1
